facts.text: Kepler Space Observatory was deployed at Earth-Trailing Heliocentric Orbit during Kepler Space Telescope in 2009.
0.95-meter Schmidt telescope with a 1.4-meter primary mirror and carbon-fiber sunshade. Weighs 1,052 kg and drifts in a perpetual Earth-trailing solar orbit.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the deep-space environment.
Proved that rocky super-Earths and sub-Neptunes are the most abundant class of planets in the galaxy, revolutionizing our understanding of planetary formation.
Status: Silent and dormant in deep space.
A permanent human and robotic monument celebrating space exploration in deep space.
